verdicts.quote: An import is all-or-nothing: any error anywhere in the file means no user is created.
`row_errors` are ordered by row then field (`email` before `name`); each is `{row, field, code}` plus `first_row` for `duplicate_in_file`

A row repeating a normalized email already present on an earlier row ... → `duplicate_in_file` carrying `first_row`; a row whose normalized email belongs to an existing user → `email_taken`. Existing users are never changed (PD-5).
The import never grants administrator rights, sets a password, or sends an email or invitation.
the import API accepts a request only from an authenticated principal the product currently treats as an administrator.
verdicts.missing: Whether the import ability is distinct from, and not implied by, permission to create a single user; finer-grained permissions are explicitly left out.

verdicts.quote: Required columns are `email` and `name`; their order is free. ... (6) header (missing, unknown, duplicate columns are all reported together)
UTF-8 (a leading byte-order mark is ignored), comma-delimited, RFC 4180 quoting (... a quoted field may contain commas and line breaks), records separated by LF or CRLF.
F-A with the store made to fail while inserting the second of three rows → 500 `import_failed` (R-8) and `ada@`, `grace@`, `alan@` all absent.
content of 524,289 bytes or more → 413 `file_too_large`; 1,001 or more data rows → 422 `too_many_rows` carrying `limit` 1000 and `found`
no non-blank record → 422 `empty_file`; ... header only → 422 `no_data_rows`. ... F-A-UPPERHDR → 201 created 1
re-posting F-A after AC-6.1 changes nothing: 422 `email_taken` for rows 2, 3 and 4, count stays 6 (a retry never duplicates).
the import runs inside one HTTP request. The response is returned only after the outcome is durable. No queue, worker, job record or status endpoint.
No passwords in the CSV, no emails sent.

a created user has the same role, status and credential state as a user created through the product's existing single-user admin path ... If ... no single-user admin path, ... non-admin with no credential, able to sign in only through ... account-recovery flow
the file's bytes exist only for the duration of one request. No copy survives the request ... no endpoint returns a past import's file, rows or report (PD-6).
other delimiters (the semicolon files some locales export are rejected, with a header error that shows it), other encodings
writes one structured log event `user_import` ... with: `import_id` ..., acting admin's id, `outcome` ... an operator can answer who imported, when, and what happened
cancelling an in-flight import (cancelling the page request would not undo a server effect)
Unresolved bound: no latency target was requested and none is invented; the numeric time limit of the deployed runtime is not known here.
verdicts.missing: A numeric time bound for a maximum-size file; progress is only a busy indicator with no progress figure.

verdicts.quote: A row whose email already exists is an error. Existing users are never updated, skipped or merged.
file content is parsed in memory ... never executed or interpreted as formulas or markup; cell values beginning `=`, `+`, `-`, `@` are stored verbatim (R-4); rendered text is escaped
